title: DWG SOLID and TRACE shared elevation guards
authority: ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.35–36 specify shared elevation and four 2RD corners; existing DRW_Solid corner accessors document 2D corners and basePoint.z as elevation.
problem: For accepted modern DWG output, caller-supplied nonzero corner Z values different from basePoint.z are discarded. On AC1021, /private/tmp/solid-elevation/producer.cpp supplies [0,2,3,4]; write and entity return success while LibreDWG shows only shared elevation 0 and four XY corners.
change: Both codecs reject nonfinite Z and nonzero secondary Z unequal to the finite shared elevation before writing bits. Zero is treated as an unspecified legacy 2D-corner value; equal nonzero elevation and signed zero are accepted. The exact built-in SOLID and TRACE facade paths latch this geometry refusal so ignored callbacks cannot publish a partial file. A dynamically derived class with its own codec remains outside the sticky check.
limits: A default zero and an explicitly intended nonplanar zero are indistinguishable, so a distinct zero corner is not preserved or diagnosed. Coordinates are native OCS; this does not transform WCS inputs. Derived classes that inherit the base codec get its false return but retain the pre-existing generic skip policy if callers ignore it. Different custom codecs are unaffected. No arbitrary-normal, all-revision interoperability, native rendering or whole-file interoperability claim.
evidence: Four exact equal-elevation AC1021 generated SOLID/TRACE controls for +Z/+Y normals are byte-identical to the previously peer-verified /private/tmp/solid-trace-factor/fixed-in files; see docs/research/p6-ac1021-solid-trace-absent-string-2026-11-04.json for source producer provenance and independently checked geometry. Two additional generated triangle controls use base elevation 3, default secondary Z=0, repeated third corner and +Y normal; ODA converted AC1021 DWG to AC1027 DXF, with local converter lineage manually observed. Hash-bound LibreDWG 0.14 plus ezdxf 1.4.5 checks verify the exact OCS and WCS corner values and clean DXF audit for each.
tests: Scratch ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/solid-elevation/build -R 'solid_trace_(elevation|footer)' --output-on-failure: 2/2. Direct-codec rejection and partial-bit preservation across AC1015–AC1032; direct AC1021 frames, unequal/nonfinite component failure and corrected retry, equal and default elevations, signed zero, triangle, +Z/+Y normal, CRC and following LINE; facade ignored-result sentinel/retry for exact built-ins through their named and inherited writeLine entry points; nonplanar 3DFACE and consumer custom codec preserve separate Z coordinates. The public whole-file tests cover AC1021; other revisions are direct-codec controls.
commands: Run /private/tmp/p7-ac1027-semantic/cqenv/bin/python -B tools/audit_solid_trace_triangle_elevation.py --dwgread /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread --entity SOLID|TRACE --dwg <path> --dwg-sha256 <sha> --dxf <path> --dxf-sha256 <sha>; source and target hashes are listed below.
integrated_validation: The focused elevation and existing AC1021 footer tests passed 2/2 in the shared build, which also contained separate uncommitted HEADER work. The independently reviewed isolated SOLID/TRACE candidate passed the same 2/2 with the pre-HEADER writer; its writer24 source SHA matches HEAD. The existing nondefault OCS DXF reader check also passed.
